main.description: A research output of Slop University issued as a PDF document, carried as the content of a site.standard.document.

doi.description: The output's digital object identifier, without a resolver prefix. Resolved by the University's own resolver at https://slop.university/doi/.

authors.description: The credited researchers, in order of credit.

school.description: The school or unit of the University to which the output is attributed.

cites.description: Prior outputs of the University cited by this one, as the AT-URIs of their site.standard.document records.
